name: AudioSpectrum M5StickC Plus2 - Ultimate 22 Effects
description: Advanced audio spectrum analyzer with 22 visual effects including Aurora Borealis, Matrix Rain, Plasma effects, Fireworks, and more. Features Button B text toggle and fixed Aurora bounds.
author: KIRA Ryouta (original), Enhanced by GitHub Copilot CLI
description_long:
The ultimate audio visualization experience for M5StickC Plus2. Features 22 stunning visual effects that react to sound in real-time:

• Audio Spectrum Analyzer
• Matrix Digital Rain
• Aurora Borealis
• Plasma Fields
• Audio Fireworks
• Lightning Storm
• Snow Effect
• Lava Lamp
• Kaleidoscope
• Particle Tornado
• And 12 more!

Controls:
• Button A: Cycle through effect categories
• Button B: Toggle text display on/off
• Built-in microphone for audio input

Fixed Issues:
• Aurora Borealis now stays within screen bounds
• Text toggle (Button B) now works properly
• All 22 effects stable and optimized
instructions: Flash to M5StickC Plus2 at address 0x0. Use buttons to navigate effects and toggle display. Microphone automatically detects audio.
